1.word_for_word: अष्टाविंशे ततो नन्दानयनं वरुणालयात् । — In the twenty-eighth chapter, Nanda was brought from the abode of Varuṇa.; वैकुण्ठ-दर्शनं चाथ गोपानाम् अनुवर्ण्यते ॥ — The story of the cowherd men’s vision of Vaikuṇṭha is also described.; गोवर्धनं समुद्धृत्य वशे कृत्वामरेश्वरम् । — He lifted Govardhana and brought him under his control.; नन्दानयनतः कृष्णो वरुणं च वशेऽनयत् ॥१॥ — By bringing Nanda, Krishna brought Varuna under his control.
1.translation: In the twenty-eighth chapter, Nanda was brought from the abode of Varuṇa. The story of the cowherd men’s vision of Vaikuṇṭha is also described. He lifted Govardhana and brought him under his control. By bringing Nanda, Krishna brought Varuna under his control.

2.word_for_word:
कला-मात्रायां द्वादश्यां पारणादराभिनिवेशेनासुरीं वेलाम् अविज्ञायारुणोदयात् पूर्वम् एव शास्त्र-बलेन निश्युदकं प्रविष्टं तद् अनभिज्ञो वरुणस्य भृत्योऽनयद् इति । — On the twelfth day of the month of Kala, when the sun was rising, the servant of Varuṇa, unaware of the fact that he had entered the night water before the dawn of the sun, did not know that it was a demoniac time.; तथा च शास्त्रम्--- — And so the scripture; > कलार्धां द्वादशीं दृष्ट्वा निशीथाद् ऊर्ध्वम् एव हि । — > Seeing the twelfth day of the half of the art, it is above nightfall.; >
> आमध्याह्नाः क्रियां सर्वाः कर्तव्याः शम्भु-शासनात् ॥ — >
> All the rituals should be performed at midday by the command of Lord Śambhu.; इत्य्-आदि । — It-etc.; वक्ष्यति च वरुणः---अजानता मामकेन [१०.२८.७] इति, भगवद्-धर्मम् अजानतेत्य् अर्थः ॥२॥ — And Varuna will say, "Ignorant of Me," meaning that he does not know the Dharma of the Lord.
2.translation:
On the twelfth day of the month of Kala, when the sun was rising, the servant of Varuṇa, unaware of the fact that he had entered the night water before the dawn of the sun, did not know that it was a demoniac time. And so the scripture > Seeing the twelfth day of the half of the art, it is above nightfall. >
> All the rituals should be performed at midday by the command of Lord Śambhu. It-etc. And Varuna will say, "Ignorant of Me," meaning that he does not know the Dharma of the Lord.

3.word_for_word: स्वानां भगवद्-धर्म-पराणाम् अभय-दो मा भैष्टेत्य् अभयं ददत् ॥३॥। — He who gives safety to his own people who are devoted to the dharma of the Lord gave them safety, saying, "Do not be afraid.
3.translation: He who gives safety to his own people who are devoted to the dharma of the Lord gave them safety, saying, "Do not be afraid.

5.word_for_word: अद्येदानीं मे मया देहो निभृतो धृतः । — Today, now, I have held my body in a calm state.; यदा त्वद्-दर्शनं जातं, तदैव देह-साफल्यं प्राप्तम् इत्य् अर्थः । — It means that when I have seen You, I have attained the success of my body.; यद् वा, निभृतः पूर्ण-मनोरथ इत्य् अर्थः । — Or rather, it means to be calm and full of desire.; किं च, अद्यैवार्थोऽधिगतः । — What’s more, I just found the meaning today.; सर्व-रत्नाकर-पतिना पीतः पूर्वं नैवं-विधोऽर्थः प्राप्त इत्य् अर्थः । — This means that the husband of all the gems has never achieved such a meaning before.; किं च, संसारोऽपि निवृत्त एवेत्य् आशयेनाह---त्वत्-पाद-भाज इति । — Moreover, with the intention that the world has also ceased, he says, “I am a vessel at Your feet.”; अध्वनः पारं मोक्षम् ॥५॥ — The crossing of the road is liberation.
5.translation: Today, now, I have held my body in a calm state. It means that when I have seen You, I have attained the success of my body. Or rather, it means to be calm and full of desire. What’s more, I just found the meaning today. This means that the husband of all the gems has never achieved such a meaning before. Moreover, with the intention that the world has also ceased, he says, “I am a vessel at Your feet.” The crossing of the road is liberation.

6.word_for_word: भगवते निरतिशयैश्वर्याय । — For the Lord’s infinite wealth.; ब्रह्मणे पूर्णाय । — Brahmane Purnaya.; परमात्मने सर्व-जीव-नियन्त्रे इति । — to the Supreme Soul, the controller of all living beings.; तत्र हेतुः---न यत्रेति । — The reason for this is that it is not where.; लोक-सृष्टिं विकल्पयति या माया, सा यत्र न श्रूयते । — The illusion that alternates the creation of the world is not heard where it is.; अविद्यमानेव तिष्ठतीत्य् अर्थः ॥६॥ — This means that it remains as if it did not exist.
6.translation: For the Lord’s infinite wealth. Brahmane Purnaya. to the Supreme Soul, the controller of all living beings. The reason for this is that it is not where. The illusion that alternates the creation of the world is not heard where it is. This means that it remains as if it did not exist.

7.word_for_word: अजानता मद्-भृत्येन त्वत्-पित्राहरणं यत् कृतं तद् इति ॥७॥ — That is what my servant has done to abduct your father without knowing it.
7.translation: That is what my servant has done to abduct your father without knowing it.

8.word_for_word: नन्दं विमुच्य समर्पयति---गोविन्देति ॥८॥ — He releases Nanda and offers him to Govinda.
8.translation: He releases Nanda and offers him to Govinda.

10.word_for_word: अतीन्द्रियम् अदृष्ट-पूर्वं लोक-पालस्य महोदयम् ऐश्वर्यम् ॥१०॥ — The greatness and opulence of the Lord of the worlds is transcendental and unprecedented.
10.translation: The greatness and opulence of the Lord of the worlds is transcendental and unprecedented.

11.word_for_word: औत्सुक्य-युक्ता धीर् येषां ते । — Those whose patience is full of curiosity.; अपि किं स्व-गतिं स्व-स्थानं सूक्ष्मां ब्रह्माख्यां चोपाधास्यद् उपाधास्यति । — Will he, however, assume his own movement, his own place, and the subtle Brahman?; नोऽस्मान् प्रापयिष्यतीति सङ्कल्पितवन्त इत्य् अर्थः ॥११॥ — This means that they resolved that he would deliver us.
11.translation: Those whose patience is full of curiosity. Will he, however, assume his own movement, his own place, and the subtle Brahman? This means that they resolved that he would deliver us.

12.word_for_word: इत्य् एवं-भूतं स्वानां तेषां सङ्कल्पम् अखिल-दृक् सर्व-ज्ञः स्वयम् एव विज्ञाय तेषां सङ्कल्प-सिद्धये कृपयैतद् वक्ष्यमाणम् अचिन्तयत् ॥१२॥ — The all-seeing and omniscient Lord Himself, having thus understood the resolve of His own people in this way, out of compassion for the fulfillment of their resolve, contemplated what was being said.
12.translation: The all-seeing and omniscient Lord Himself, having thus understood the resolve of His own people in this way, out of compassion for the fulfillment of their resolve, contemplated what was being said.

13.word_for_word: अविद्या देहाद्य्-अहं-बुद्धिः, ततः कामः, ततः कर्म, तैर् उच्चावचासु देव-तिर्यग्-आदिषु भ्रमन् स्वीयां गतिं न वेद ॥१३॥ — Ignorance is the body, the ego, the intellect, then lust, then action, and wandering about in these higher orders, such as the gods, animals and the like, he does not know his own course.
13.translation: Ignorance is the body, the ego, the intellect, then lust, then action, and wandering about in these higher orders, such as the gods, animals and the like, he does not know his own course.

14.word_for_word: स्वं ब्रह्म-स्वरूपं लोकं वैकुण्ठाख्यं च । — His own Brahman-form is the world called Vaikuṇṭha.; तमसः प्रकृतेः परम् ॥१४॥ — Beyond the darkness of nature.
14.translation: His own Brahman-form is the world called Vaikuṇṭha. Beyond the darkness of nature.

15.word_for_word: देहादि-पिहितानां दर्शनम् अशक्यम् इति प्रथमं देहादि-व्यतिरिक्तं ब्रह्म-स्वरूपं दर्शयाम् आस । — He first showed that it is impossible to see those who are covered by the body and other things.; तद् आह---सत्यम् इति । — He argues that it is true.; सत्यम् अबाध्यं ज्ञानम् अजडम् अनन्तम् अपरिच्छिन्नं ज्योतिः स्व-प्रकाशं सनातनं शश्वत् सिद्धं ब्रह्मगुणापाये गुणापोहे ज्ञानिनो यत् पश्यन्ति, तत् कृपयैव दर्शयाम् आस ॥१५॥ — He was mercifully showing me the truth, the unbound knowledge, the immovable, infinite, uninterrupted light, the self-illuminating, eternal, eternally perfect, which the knowers see in the destruction of the modes of the Absolute Truth.
15.translation: He first showed that it is impossible to see those who are covered by the body and other things. He argues that it is true. He was mercifully showing me the truth, the unbound knowledge, the immovable, infinite, uninterrupted light, the self-illuminating, eternal, eternally perfect, which the knowers see in the destruction of the modes of the Absolute Truth.

16.word_for_word: एवं ब्रह्म-ह्रदं ब्रह्मैव ह्रदवद् ध्रदः । — Thus, the Brahma-Hrada is the Brahma-Hrada, just as the Brahma-Hrada is the lake.; तत्र निमग्नस्य विशेष-विज्ञानाभावात् तं ब्रह्म-ह्रदं ते तु नीताः प्रापिताः, तस्मिन् मग्नाश् च । — Because of the lack of special knowledge of those who were immersed there they were taken to that lake of Brahma and reached it and were immersed in it; तु-शब्दोक्तं विशेषम् आह---पुनः कृष्णेनोद्धृताः समाधेर् इवोत्थापिताः सन्तो ब्रह्मणस् तस्यैव लोकं वैकुण्ठाख्यं ददृशुर् इति । — He argues that the specialty mentioned in the word tu is that the saints, who were again lifted up by Kṛṣṇa as if from trance, saw the same world of Brahmā called Vaikuṇṭha.; ननु ब्रह्म-निमग्नानां पुनर् लोक-दर्शनम् अघटितम् एवेत्य् आशङ्क्याह---यत्रेति । — If, indeed, those who are immersed in the Absolute Truth have never seen the world again, he doubts that it has happened.; यत्र यस्मिन् कृष्णे निमित्ते सति पूर्वम् अक्रूरोऽध्यगाद् दृष्टवान् । — Wherever and on whatever occasion Akrūra had previously visited Lord Kṛṣṇa, He had seen Him.; शुक-परीक्षित्-संवादात् प्राक्तनत्वाद् भूत-निर्देशः । — The conversation between Shuka and Parikshit is an indication of the past because it is ancient.; न ह्य् अतर्क्यैश्वर्ये भगवति किञ्चिद् अप्य् असम्भावितम् इति भावः । — This means that nothing is impossible for the Supreme Personality of Godhead in His inconceivable opulence.; अथवा, अक्रूरो यत्र दृष्टवांस् तस्य यमुना-ह्रदस्य ब्रह्म-ह्रद इति नाम । — Or, the lake of Yamuna where Akrura saw it is called Brahma-hrada.; तं ह्रदं नीताः सन्तो ब्रह्मणो लोकं ददृशुः । — The saints were taken to that lake and saw the world of the Brahman.; पुनश् च कृष्णेनोद्धृताः पूर्ववत् तं दृष्ट्वा विस्मिता बभूवुः । — They were again lifted up by Lord Kṛṣṇa and were astonished to see Him as before.; व्यवहितान्वयोऽप्रसिद्ध-कल्पना च सोढव्येति ॥१६॥ — The consequences of the determined and the imagination of the unknown should be tolerated.
16.translation: Thus, the Brahma-Hrada is the Brahma-Hrada, just as the Brahma-Hrada is the lake. Because of the lack of special knowledge of those who were immersed there they were taken to that lake of Brahma and reached it and were immersed in it He argues that the specialty mentioned in the word tu is that the saints, who were again lifted up by Kṛṣṇa as if from trance, saw the same world of Brahmā called Vaikuṇṭha. If, indeed, those who are immersed in the Absolute Truth have never seen the world again, he doubts that it has happened. Wherever and on whatever occasion Akrūra had previously visited Lord Kṛṣṇa, He had seen Him. The conversation between Shuka and Parikshit is an indication of the past because it is ancient. This means that nothing is impossible for the Supreme Personality of Godhead in His inconceivable opulence. Or, the lake of Yamuna where Akrura saw it is called Brahma-hrada. The saints were taken to that lake and saw the world of the Brahman. They were again lifted up by Lord Kṛṣṇa and were astonished to see Him as before. The consequences of the determined and the imagination of the unknown should be tolerated.
